{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Republicans recognize that each tribe has the right of consultation before any new regulatory policy is implemented on tribal land.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"To the extent possible, consultation should take place in Indian country with the tribal government and its members.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Before promulgating and imposing any new laws or regulations affecting trust land or members, the federal government should encourage Indian tribes to develop their own policies to achieve program objectives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The federal government should defer to tribes to develop their own standards, or standards in conjunction with State governments.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans reject a one-size-fits-all approach to federal-tribal-State partnerships.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will work to expand local autonomy where tribal governments seek it.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Better partnerships will help expand economic opportunity.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Better partnerships will help deliver top-flight education to future generations.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Better partnerships will help modernize and improve the Indian Health Service to make it more responsive to local needs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Better partnerships will help build essential infrastructure in Indian country in cooperation with tribal neighbors.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans aim to empower American Indians through tribal self-determination and self-governance policies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans aim to empower American Indians to develop their greatest assets, human resources and the rich natural resources on their lands.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans aim to empower American Indians without undue federal interference.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
